failure_boundary.login_required: No managed identity fact; return unavailable.
failure_boundary.permission_insufficient: Control owner is not confirmed; do not execute.
failure_boundary.page_changed: Route or field targets differ; stop.
failure_boundary.field_unavailable: Title/body is not uniquely editable; stop.
failure_boundary.validation_failed: Page readback does not match the requested value.
failure_boundary.operation_result_unknown: Expose operation ref and reconcile; no retry.
failure_boundary.post_check_failed: Required readback or refs are missing.
failure_boundary.reconciliation_unknown: Operation exists but page state cannot be reconciled.
